clips.title: The story
paras: Sven Yorgen is a grieving farmer camped on the northern edge of the Hushed Bank in western Duskwood, accompanied by his companion Lars. Having survived the brutal slaughter of his family at the Yorgen Farmstead, Sven is consumed by a relentless drive to uncover who brought ruin upon his home and exact vengeance.

Sven was born before the First War, old enough to recall the days before the region became shrouded in gloom following Medivh's fall. For years he worked the soil at the Yorgen Farmstead in southern Duskwood alongside his wife and children. That quiet existence ended in sudden violence when mysterious Dark Riders raided his homestead while he was away, butchering his family and turning the farm into a graveyard.

Unable to return to the ruins of his home, Sven established a secluded refuge on the Hushed Bank with his friend Lars. Distrustful of outsiders, he demands proof of loyalty from travelers before sharing his burden. Sven spotted a skulking figure lurking near his devastated farmstead and became convinced this interloper was either directly responsible for the massacre or tied to the sinister horsemen who tore his world apart.
